supraorbital_contour.structural_silhouette: strongly M-shaped with a distinct central depression
supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: The brow ridge extends laterally beyond the ocular corners by a distance roughly equal to one-third of the ocular width on each side.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast; the muzzle area consists of light grey/white pixels while the periocular and cheek regions are dark black/brown.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Thin vertical 2D profile with a tightly closed, horizontal lip line and no visible structural droop.

pinna_silhouette.outer_helix_geometry: Rounded macro-silhouette visible on both lateral aspects of the cranium.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a distinct white/grey hair concentration along the inferior mandibular boundary, forming a beard.
